lines.en: Rod on my shoulder, I walk the riverbank.

lines.zh: 网挂在腰上，我走得不快。
lines.en: Net at my hip, I don't walk fast.

lines.zh: 我踩过湿地，脚下咕的一声。
lines.en: I cross the wet ground and it squelches.

lines.zh: 我抬头看云，判断下午的风。
lines.en: I look at the clouds to read the afternoon wind.

lines.zh: 我绕开泥坑，鞋已经湿了。
lines.en: I skirt the mud pit; my shoes are already wet.

lines.zh: 我沿着上回打窝的地方去。
lines.en: I head for where I baited the water last time.
I pause at the bend in the river.
My rod tip bobs with every step.
I count the rings spreading on the water.
I walk the levee to its end.
I walk back with an empty bucket.

lines.zh: 我脚下有青苔，走得很小心。
lines.en: There's moss underfoot, so I step carefully.

lines.zh: 我站着，眼睛盯在水面上。
lines.en: I stand with my eyes on the water.
I let out another foot of line.
I chew a grass stem and wait.

lines.zh: 浮标动了一下，又不动了。
lines.en: The float twitches, then stops.
I push my wide hat back.

lines.zh: 我坐在岸边，数鱼漂的起伏。
lines.en: I sit on the bank, counting the bobber's dips.
Three in the basket — enough.

lines.zh: 我在等鱼把浮标拖下去。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a fish to pull the float under.
The wind comes upriver — just right.
I tuck the rod under my arm to rest.
The water looks like old sheet metal.
I hear a bird hitting the water far off.
I bait the hook again.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我该换位置了。
lines.en: The sun's shifted; time to move.

lines.zh: 你是来买鱼的，还是来问路的？
lines.en: Are you here for fish, or for directions?

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了挡太阳看你。
lines.en: I shade my eyes to look at you.
They're not biting today.
You've got river mud on you.
Don't stand on my line.

lines.zh: 这条河边我有三个好位置。
lines.en: I've got three good spots along this bank.

lines.zh: 你脚步太重，把鱼都惊了。
lines.en: You step too heavy; you've scared the fish.
I don't sell the lively ones.
Hold on — the float's moving.
Give the rod a hold for me.

lines.zh: 你问这河有多深？够淹人。
lines.en: How deep? Deep enough to drown a man.

lines.zh: 我认识每一个在这条河上的人。
lines.en: I know everyone who works this river.
Are you in trade as well?
The weather's turning; you should go early.
I've been here since first light.
The mud on your soles is from upstream.

lines.zh: 这鱼不好抓，别看我看着容易。
lines.en: It's not easy fishing, whatever it looks like.
If you're waiting, stand further off.
I grunt and drop to a crouch.

lines.zh: 我肩上的鱼篓翻进了水里。
lines.en: The creel on my shoulder tips into the water.
I drop the rod and cover my ribs.
Blood drips into the mud.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，没掉进河里。
lines.en: I step back without going into the river.
Teeth gritted, I right the bucket.

lines.zh: 鱼竿差点脱手，我攥紧了。
lines.en: The rod nearly slips; I grip it tighter.
I can still lift the spear.

lines.zh: 渔网还没收，先挨了一下。
lines.en: The net's still out, and I took a hit.

lines.zh: 别打了，我今天没带家伙。
lines.en: Enough — I'm not armed for this today.
Buying fish? I'm not cheap.
This basket's from this morning.
I don't need what you're offering.

lines.zh: 你要真有好饵，我倒是想要。
lines.en: Good bait, though — that I'd take.
This smells like it would draw fish.
I'll trade two fish for that.
Deal — I'll take it.
Got more? I'll take it all.
Don't wave it about; the fish can see.

lines.zh: 有这东西，今天不会空手。
lines.en: With this, I won't go home empty.

lines.zh: 哎，看着点，我竿差点折了。
lines.en: Hey — watch it, you nearly snapped my rod.

lines.zh: 你撞得我一脚踩进水里。
lines.en: You knocked me a foot into the water.
My bucket tipped and the fish got out.
Sorry, I backed up too quickly.
We're crowded on this narrow levee.

lines.zh: 你站稳，别把我也带下去。
lines.en: Hold on — don't take me with you.

lines.zh: 这一下我心口都撞疼了。
lines.en: That knocked the wind out of me.
I gather my net and clear the way.
Careful, it's all mud underfoot.
Fine — the rod's still in my hand.
Someone's waiting for me at home.
Today's catch is good for two meals.

lines.zh: 我把篓子提起来，往家走。
lines.en: I lift the basket and head home.
She'll complain that I'm late first.

lines.zh: 我把最肥的那条留给她。
lines.en: I keep the fattest one for her.

lines.zh: 这味道得先用清水泡一泡。
lines.en: This needs soaking in clean water first.
The roof's leaking; I'll have to fix it.
A house is only home with someone in it.
I scrape the mud off at the door.
The lamp's still lit, so I'm home.

lines.zh: 我把掉进河里的桶捞起来。
lines.en: I fish the fallen bucket out of the river.

lines.zh: 这条鱼跳出来了，抓回来。
lines.en: A fish jumped out; I grab it back.
I pick up an old hook.
Line snapped. I'll still use it.
I stuff it into my pouch.
Too rotten; a fish would snap it.
I take a piece of driftwood.
This stone will weigh the net down.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我脚一伸勾回来。
lines.en: It dropped; I hook it back with my foot.
Rings spread across the water.
I tighten my grip on the rod.
The float's gone under.
No rush; let it take the bait properly.
Something behind me — not a duck.
I lay the rod down on the bank.
I can't retreat from here.
I snatch up the fish spear.
I'm fixed on that shadow.
I know what makes that kind of splash.
I kick the bucket aside.
It's in the water, I'm on the bank.

lines.zh: 风正好把我的味道带走。
lines.en: The wind happens to carry my smell away.
I'm judging how far it is from the bank.

lines.zh: 我把外衣解了，随时能下水。
lines.en: I've loosed my coat to go in the water.
I walk slowly along the bank.

lines.zh: 它在水里，我一直看得见。
lines.en: It's in the water and stays in sight.
I carry the spear at my shoulder.
It heads for deep water; I wait.
I crouch lower.
Its prints are in the mud.
I follow the prints.
I keep the light behind me.
The water starts making noise.
It's climbing out; I see it.
I'm counting how many rod-lengths away it is.
No hurry; nothing outruns mud.
I put my feet down softly.
It's waiting for something; so am I.

lines.zh: 我换了个角度遮住影子。
lines.en: I shift to hide my shadow.
There's nowhere to retreat on this levee.
Time for me to strike.
I drive the spear down.
The spear slides off its scales.
I swing the rod butt across.
I shove it toward the shallows.
That one went into its flank.
It threw water all over me.
I step back and raise the spear again.
The net drops and it can't get free.
I push forward through the mud.
It thrashed and my rod bent double.
I haul it up onto the bank.

lines.zh: 我抄起鱼竿，朝你挥过去。
lines.en: I swing my fishing rod at you.
That caught my elbow.

lines.zh: 我的脚滑了一下，叉扎偏了。
lines.en: My foot slipped and the spear went wide.
It withdrew; I don't follow into deep water.
Lucky for it this time.
I walk up to the river with my rod.
First the color of the water, then the wind.
I set up my folding stool.
Nobody's taken this spot.
I bait the hook and cast.
The float stands steady on the water.
It isn't fully light yet.
I set the bucket by my feet.
Water's got into my boots; it's cold.
I pull my hat brim down.
Someone's hauling nets far off.
Good wind today.
I spit on my palms.
I raise the rod over my shoulder.
I know this river well.
Nothing moving on the water yet.
I'm waiting for the first one.

lines.zh: 我从堤上滑下去，摔在石头上。
lines.en: I slide off the levee and land on stone.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我抓不住东西。
lines.en: Water floods my nose and I grab at nothing.
An arrow buries in my thigh.

lines.zh: 有什么东西顺着骨头往上爬。
lines.en: Something crawls up along my bones.
Not a bite today; my hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 雷打在河面上，我整条腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and my whole leg goes numb.
The riverbed gives way and I fall.
